_source: Evil Mode rework (DOMINION) slice D3, the crew. Design: /mnt/project-files/plans/evil-mode-rework/ Part 2 (the crew), Part 8 section 2 (ranks: order, member level, pay), Part 9 A16-A18 and A24, Part 6 section 4 (the Assign Task card). Temperaments for Lost, Soft and Starstruck, the fifteen unnamed Signature traits, the six Patrons' jobs and four of their perks, the A24 names per region, the candidate classes and the lines are this slice's own writing (Part 2 names only some). Numbers are starting values; none are playtested.

greens.name: Nervous
greens.effect: −10% Nerve tasks; flees a raid defense at half HP

greens.name: Lazy
greens.effect: 15% chance to skip the task entirely

greens.name: Soft
greens.effect: Refuses Shake Down on kind shopkeepers

greens.name: Lost
greens.effect: 10% chance to do the task in the wrong district

greens.name: Starstruck

formed.name: Road Hog

formed.name: Iron-Nerved
formed.text: Never flees a raid.

formed.name: Immovable
formed.text: Guard defends two buildings.

formed.name: Climber

formed.name: Ghost-in-Training

formed.name: Fencer

formed.text: Lab room effects +20%.

formed.name: Oracle

formed.name: Orator

formed.name: Persuader
formed.text: Pitch odds +10% for the whole crew.

formed.name: Trailwise
formed.text: Catch in caves +20%.

formed.name: Bug Whisperer
formed.text: Bug-types in his team +10 level cap.

formed.name: Clutch
formed.text: First turn of a defense battle is his.

formed.name: Gentle Hands
formed.text: Caught Pokémon start +10 Loyalty.

formed.name: Nurturer
formed.text: Stored Pokémon level while he rests.

formed.name: Patient
formed.text: Catch at water routes +20%.

formed.name: Field Medic
formed.text: Injured crew heal a day sooner.

formed.name: Alpha Handler
formed.text: His lead Pokémon never flees.

formed.name: Trapper
formed.text: Guard sets one tripwire per night.

formed.text: Reads a rival's next move once a week.

formed.name: Eye in the Sky
formed.text: Scout never makes the target "on guard".

formed.name: Broadcaster
formed.text: Flyers reach a second district.

formed.name: Sea Legs
formed.text: Smuggle by sea never fails in storms.

formed.name: Mirage

signatures.name: Ghost
signatures.text: Their spy missions can't be discovered.

signatures.name: Kingmaker
signatures.text: A held region's betrayal checks are rolled at half chance.

signatures.name: Warlord
signatures.text: Raids they lead get a free first turn.

signatures.name: The Vault
signatures.text: Thieves never take money from the HQ.

signatures.name: Drill Sergeant
signatures.text: Everyone on Train gets +1 XP a day.

signatures.name: Silver Tongue
signatures.text: One failed Pitch a week can be tried again at once.

signatures.name: Night Owl
signatures.text: Night tasks never fail on a mishap.

signatures.name: Rainmaker
signatures.text: Every Front pays +10%.

signatures.name: Cartographer
signatures.text: Scouting saves two Boss actions, not one.

signatures.name: Beast Master
signatures.text: Catches come in at the HQ level cap.

signatures.text: Personal Heat never rises above 40.

motives.name: Belonging
motives.text: A good HQ, a good squad.

motives.name: Revenge
motives.text: A named enemy to go after.

motives.name: Fear
motives.text: Your Dread. Leaves the moment you look weak.

clumsy: I got the money, Boss! ...Most of it. Some of it. There was a Pidgey.
I'll be careful. I'm always careful. That's why the door's off its hinge.
nervous: Is that a siren? That's a siren. Boss, that's a siren.
I'll do it. I'll do it. Just... don't watch me do it.
lazy: I was resting my eyes, Boss. Both of them. On purpose.
Tomorrow. Tomorrow I'll be a legend. Tonight I'm a blanket.
loudmouth: Did everyone hear what I did? I'll tell them again.
I told the noodle stand we're the toughest crew in Kanto. They laughed. I laughed louder.
greedy: The take was light today, Boss. Lighter than my pockets, anyway.
A cut for the crew, a cut for the Boss, a cut for... the cutting.
soft: She gave me tea, Boss. I couldn't take her money after tea.
I'll stand guard. Guarding doesn't hurt anybody.
lost: I'm back! I think this is back. Is this the warehouse?
I found a whole new street, Boss. I wasn't looking for it.
starstruck: Boss, that was a GYM LEADER. Did you see the cape? Was it a cape?
If I win one big battle, they'll put me on a card. A card!
steady: Nobody gets past this door. Not the cops, not Rocket, not the kid. Go to sleep, Boss. I've got it.
Same door, same night, same answer: no.
cold-blooded: The shopkeeper paid. They always pay when you don't blink.
Heat? I don't feel heat, Boss.
smooth-talker: He thanked me for the chance to pay. Can you believe it?
Words cost nothing, Boss. That's why they're profit.
light-fingered: Wallet, watch, his lunch. He'll miss the lunch most.
Hands like a Sneasel. Quiet like one too.
driven: Again. Again. One more round, then again.
Yesterday's me couldn't beat today's me. Tomorrow's me is scary.
charismatic: I brought a friend. And their friend. And their friend's Machop.
People like me, Boss. Let me use it for us.
honest-accountant: Every coin counted. Twice. You can sleep, Boss.
Late is expensive. Early is free.
embezzler: The numbers are fine, Boss. Don't look at the numbers.
Wages were late. I paid myself. Fair's fair.
resentful: Yes, Boss. Whatever you say, Boss.
I remember every time you shouted. Every time.
pathfinder: There's an alley behind the alley. Nobody knows it but me.
Give me a map and I'll give you a shortcut.
respectable: The shop's spotless, the customers smile, and nobody asks questions.
A clean front is the best mask, Boss.
rival-killer: Famous trainers bleed like the rest. Their Pokémon do, anyway.
Bring me the big names, Boss.
trait: I'm not who I was on Day {joined}. I'm {trait} now.

patrons.name: Mr. Halloway
patrons.rumour: An old man in a good coat keeps buying drinks for Grunts and telling them they're doing it wrong.
patrons.jobText: Hold the door five nights without a thief getting in.

patrons.name: Ms. Kettering
patrons.rumour: A woman who used to wear a badge on her coat trains alone at the old Gym's back door.
patrons.jobText: Show her six honest days of training.

patrons.name: Dr. Ashgrove
patrons.rumour: A Professor lost his licence and kept his notes. He sells them by the page.

patrons.name: Daria
patrons.rumour: Somebody saw a former Champion feeding Pidgey in the park, every day at noon.
patrons.jobText: Bring her four good people worth meeting.
patrons.perk: Training XP +1 for everyone on Train.

patrons.name: Old Jory
patrons.who: a Grunt who's seen three Bosses
patrons.rumour: An old Grunt in a faded uniform says he's outlived three Bosses and he'll outlive you.
patrons.perk: Members never quit on the weekly roll while he's around.

patrons.name: Nobody
patrons.rumour: Nobody knows who Nobody is. Nobody wants to meet you.
patrons.perk: Personal Heat cools 5 faster for the whole crew.

recruit.noCauseLine: You don't stand for anything yet. (The Founding gives the team a Goal.)

pitches.name: Cause
pitches.text: Match your Goal to their values.

pitches.name: Fear
pitches.text: A threat. They join with low Loyalty.

lawyer.text: Cuts Heat: region Heat −1 a night, crew personal Heat −3 a night.

nurse.text: Free healing: injured crew heal a day sooner.

fence.text: Opens the Fence (sell stolen goods at full value).

says.yes: "Fine. But I want my own locker."
says.notYet: "Not yet. Come back when you're more than a warehouse."
says.full: There's no room at the HQ. They'll wait {days} days on the waiting list.

report.guardHeld: {name} guarded the HQ. A thief ran.
report.thief: A thief got in while nobody watched the door. −₽{amount}.
report.arrested: {name} was arrested. Bail ₽{bail}, or {days} days in a cell.
report.pickedUp: Officers picked up {name} on old business. Bail ₽{bail}, or {days} days in a cell.
report.wandered: {name} did {task} in the wrong district. Wasted day.
report.injured: {name} hurt themself training. Out for {days} day.
report.scout: {name} scouted the area. +{n} Day action today.
report.steal: {name} came back with a {mon} (Lv {level}). The owner was out.
report.audit: {name} went through the books. ₽{amount} was missing; {who} had it. It's back.
report.auditClean: {name} went through the books. Every coin is there.
report.welcome: {name} made the new faces feel at home.
report.rally: {name} rallied the crew. Morale +{n} all round.
report.stole: {name} took ₽{amount} from the cash box and is gone.
report.soldOut: {name} talked to the police about you. Heat +{heat}.
report.waitGone: {cand} gave up on the waiting list and left.

talks.name: First Day Jitters
talks.text: {name} asks what the job really is.

talks.name: The Pep Talk
talks.text: {name} looks flat before the job. A few words?

talks.name: Tell Me a Secret
talks.text: {name} confesses something: a fear, a debt, a crush.

talks.name: Ask for a Raise
talks.text: {name} asks for more money.

talks.name: Pat on the Back
talks.text: {name} did well yesterday.

talks.name: Dressing Down
talks.text: {name} botched yesterday's job.

talks.name: Share a Meal
talks.text: Noodles for two? It costs ₽40.

choices.label: Eat together (₽40)
choices.memory: We ate noodles and the Boss paid.

talks.name: The Nickname
talks.text: The crew wants a name for {name}.

talks.name: Cover for Me
talks.text: The police want {name}. They ask you to say the job was yours.

talks.name: Personal Favour
talks.text: {name} asks you to find their pawned Pokémon. It'll cost tomorrow's first action.

talks.name: Confession of Doubt
talks.text: {name} wonders if this crew can win at all.

talks.name: Promotion Day
talks.text: {name} has met the bar for the next rank, and a seat is open. A short ceremony in the Mess: a new armband, a few words from you.

talks.name: Passed Over
talks.text: Someone else got the seat {name} wanted. {name} sulks by the door.

talks.name: The Gift
talks.text: {name} keeps looking at something in your bag.

talks.name: Birthday
talks.text: It's {name}'s birthday. A cake costs ₽60.

choices.label: Join the party (₽60)
choices.memory: The Boss came to my birthday.

talks.name: Late Night Chat
talks.text: {name} couldn't sleep either. You talked until the rain stopped.

talks.name: Ask for Time Off
talks.text: {name} has worked ten days straight and asks for a day off.

talks.name: Homesick
talks.text: {name} misses home.

talks.name: Test of Nerve
talks.text: Send {name} on a small scare job?

talks.name: Teach Them to Read the Map
talks.text: You could walk the district with {name}.

talks.name: A Boss's Lie
talks.text: {name} knows you never kept that promise.

talks.name: Hear Them Out
talks.text: {name} has something to say. Listen?

talks.name: Draw a Line
talks.text: {name} won't {task}. It's their line.

talks.name: Second Chance
talks.text: {name} got caught. The crew watches what you do.

talks.name: Show Them the Ledger
talks.text: You have money to spare. Open the books to {name}?

talks.name: The Oath
talks.text: {name} wears the full uniform now. You ask for the oath.

choices.label: Take the oath
choices.memory: I swore the oath to the Boss.

talks.name: Boss Takes the Blame
talks.text: The job went badly and the crew expects blame.

talks.name: Boss Takes the Credit
talks.text: A job went brilliantly. Whose name goes on it?

talks.name: Goodbye
talks.text: {name}'s last evening with the crew.
